title: Braised Napa Cabbage Bao
description: A twist on traditional bao, this recipe pairs tender napa cabbage with a savory braised filling, served in a delicate chinese bao bun.

ingredients.name: nappa cabbage
ingredients.notes: cabbage is typically shredded before use

ingredients.name: chinese bao buns
ingredients.notes: found in most asian grocery stores

instructions: Steam napa cabbage for 5-7 minutes until tender.
Mix braised cabbage filling with sesame oil (if using), soy sauce (if using), salt, and pepper (if using).
Split chinese bao buns in half and toast until lightly browned.
Spoon braised cabbage filling into bao buns.
Note: Bao buns can be toasted or steamed before use for added texture.
